color.summary: Near-black #0b0c0c text on white, #484949 for secondary text, #cecece borders and #f3f3f3 for plates and inactive tabs. Links are blue #1a65a6, the header and brand blue #1d70b8, and the main button green #0f7a52. Focus is a yellow #ffdd00 fill, not a ring. Live gov.uk sets its footer and feedback band on a pale blue #f4f8fb.
missing: Light only: GOV.UK has no dark theme (39 of 40 live pages shot in dark were identical).

type.summary: GDS Transport (licensed to gov.uk, with Arial as its fallback) at 19px on a 25px line for body copy and form labels, 16px for small print and the header. Headings are 700: 48px page titles, 24px and 19px section heads. Big question labels step up to 36px.

shape.summary: Square: no corner radius anywhere except a 1px on tags. Fields, radios and checkboxes draw a 2px black edge; radios are the one round shape.

spacing.summary: On a 5px scale: 10, 15, 20 and 30px are the common steps. Fields are 40px, buttons about 38px plus their 2px lip, the header 61px.

elevation.summary: No soft shadows. Buttons stand on a solid 2px lip (#083d29 under green, #858686 under grey) that disappears when pressed; the feedback buttons use a 3px black one.

button.summary: govuk-button: 19px text, square corners, a solid 2px lip in a darker shade. The default is green (Save and continue); secondary is a #f3f3f3 plate (Find address). Focus turns any button yellow with black text and a black lip; disabled ones drop to 50% opacity.

card.summary: GOV.UK draws few boxes. Panels are flat colored blocks (the green confirmation), related content hangs under a 2px blue top rule, and the summary card is a 1px #cecece box with a grey title band. No card has a shadow or radius.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 154a8a6) and its page shots: five live gov.uk pages and ten GOV.UK Design System examples, light only. Names marked docs come from the Design System; ai names are ours.
